def is_palindrome(text: str) -> bool:
    """
    Checks if given string is a palindrome.
    
    >>> is_palindrome('')
    True
    >>> is_palindrome('aba')
    True
    >>> is_palindrome('aaaaa')
    True
    >>> is_palindrome('zbcd')
    False
    >>> is_palindrome('abba')
    True
    """
    # Compare the string with its reverse
    return text == text[::-1]
